messages:
incbot: ALERT: Spike in gateway errors and timeouts in region us-west-2 for /v1/chat and /v1/generate. 5xx rolling 5m = 22%, p95 latency ~20s. Queue depth growth observed on continuous-batcher pools. Paging @maya (oncall) @eng-sre @eng-runtime

maya (oncall): acknowledged. pulling metrics now. seeing a rapid growth in enqueued requests on pool-continuous-usw2-01 and -02, total queue ~38k, oldest waiting ~135s.

jared (eng-sre): pattern looks like head-of-line blocking from a small set of very long requests (8-12k tokens). gateway is retrying and amplifying load. we're seeing 502s from runner timeouts and 504s at gateway.

li (eng-runtime): confirmed. the runner threads are saturated by long-run decode loops. scheduler doesn't preempt mid-generation; KV handles per-request are high. will try config swap to enable soft-preemption and reduce batch max latency.

nora (observability-bot): Alert context: cpu/runner-3=94% | batch_queue_depth=39320 | host_errors_gw=18% | outstanding_kv_handles=720 | recent_deployments=none in last 30m

olga (support): multiple customers opened high-priority tickets reporting intermittent 5xx and app timeouts. Enterprise customer ACME (ID C-998) seeing cascading retries. Logging indicates retries from our SDK too.

maya (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) enable region-level fallback routing to cpu-backed smaller model for non-enterprise traffic 2) temporarily lower batch_window_ms to 25ms on affected pools 3) spin up +3 nodes to provide relief 4) enable scheduler.soft_preempt=true. Implementing now.

kai (infra): scaling pools: running add nodes to pool-continuous-usw2-01: ``infractl cluster add --pool pool-continuous-usw2-01 --count 3`` ETA ~65s for LB join.

li (eng-runtime): applying runtime changes: PATCH /runtime/pools/pool-continuous-usw2-01 {"batch_window_ms":"25","soft_preempt":true} 
Applying patch to pool-continuous-usw2-02 as well.

jared (eng-sre): routing change: policy set to route customer_tier!=enterprise to redwood-lite-quant via policy patch. enterprise still pinned to original capacity.```
PATCH /routing/policies/us-west-2
{"fallback_model":"redwood-lite-quant","condition":"customer_tier!=enterprise"}
```

incbot: config changes applied. autoscale event triggered by kai.

maya (oncall): support: please notify impacted customers with an interim message pointing to mitigation and expected next update in 15m. Samir, prepare a short quality note for enterprise teams about possible fallback differences.

samir (product): drafting comms: "We've detected elevated timeouts in us-west-2. We've applied routing fallbacks and increased capacity; you may see slightly different output if routed to lite model. We're monitoring and will update in 15 minutes."

olga (support): sent to affected tickets C-998, C-1012, C-1044.

jared (eng-sre): metrics after changes: 5xx down from 22% -> 7% in ~90s, p95 latency dropped to 5.4s, queue depth reduced to ~9k. Some HOL still causing occasional spikes. Preemption logs show evictions working.

li (eng-runtime): noticed high occupancy of KV handles: many requests hold >48 handles; pool default max_kv_handles=48. temporary mitigation: reduce to 28 and set kvcache_eviction_ttl=45s. PATCH applied.

kai (infra): kvcache and runtime patches applied across the two pools. watching node health.

nora (observability-bot): System update: p95 latency=5.4s | 5xx=6.8% | batch_queue_total=9120 | kv_handles_total=312

maya (oncall): I'm going to keep pager open for 30m and watch SLOs. If stable, will demote to watch-only. Jared, please own the immediate post-incident follow-up and add note to runbook about token-length thresholds.

jared (eng-sre): grabbing logs for timeline. snippet from scheduler: ``[2025-02-12T03:07:12Z] scheduler(pool=pool-continuous-usw2-01): enqueue=38912 head_time=134s req=zzz-402 size=10240 handles=52 state=running`` then ``[2025-02-12T03:07:14Z] scheduler: preempted req=zzz-402 reason=soft_preempt_timeout`` and gateway responded with 504 for that request.

li (eng-runtime): postmortem action items: - add per-request token-length rejection at gateway above 12k tokens - flag scheduling preemption as canary feature before full rollouts - instrument kv handle pressure metric in the console with alert when >70% capacity - consider early-reject responses (413-like) for extreme-length prompts with SDK guidance.

samir (product): also recommend updating docs/SDK to include guidance and default client-side token limits to prevent accidental huge prompts from user apps.

olga (support): will keep customers updated; will escalate if we get fresh errors after mitigations.

incbot: UPDATE: mitigations applied; severity reduced to SEV-2. Next auto-update in 15m or on status change.

maya (oncall): handing over to watch rotation but staying on slack for any escalations for the next 20m. closing primary page at current stability but keeping incident in monitoring. Please add any additional findings to incident tracker ID INC-2025-022.

nora (observability-bot): final notification before closing page: region us-west-2 5xx=2.1% p95=3.8s queue=2.2k at 1738001645

incbot: INCIDENT TRANSITION -> monitoring. final severity SEV-3 at 1738001645.
